target.title: Inline image previews and stable chat-list selection in web viewer
target.body:
Follow-up to #35 with two behaviors: real inline images and a sidebar that stays put when you switch chats.

## Inline images

Photos, stickers, and GIFs now render inside bubbles instead of metadata cards, with a click-to-zoom lightbox.

- New `GET /api/media?pk=<source_pk>` endpoint behind the same loopback bearer auth. It streams bytes from the local `media_path` our importer wrote (WhatsApp container or archive `media/` copy) and refuses everything else: only messages whose metadata says image/sticker/GIF, only regular files, 25 MB cap, and the first 512 bytes must content-sniff as `image/*`. Paths are never exposed; other attachment types (video, audio, documents…) stay metadata cards.
- The client lazy-loads previews near the viewport (`IntersectionObserver`, 500px margin), fetches with the bearer token, and renders via cached object URLs — CSP `img-src` gains `blob:`, everything else unchanged (`default-src 'none'`, no inline script/style). Blobs are cached per conversation so "Load older" never refetches, and revoked on view switch.
- Anything without a usable local file falls back to the existing metadata card.
- Bubbles hug the image WhatsApp-style (fun one: `max-width: min(330px, 100%)` let the image's natural width inflate the bubble because percentages are ignored during intrinsic sizing — now definite lengths only).

## Stable chat navigation

Opening a chat previously re-rendered the whole sidebar: scroll position reset and the entrance animation replayed. Now:

- Selection just retargets the `active` row in place (`data-jid` lookup) — the list DOM is untouched, scroll position survives, and `aria-selected` stays correct.
- The staggered entrance animation plays only on the very first paint, not on filters, refreshes, or search-mode changes.

## Screenshots (fictional demo archive)

**Inline photo in a group chat, dark**
![crew dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/wacrawl/webui-inline-images/docs/assets/webui-chat-dark.png)

**Light theme**
![mom light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/wacrawl/webui-inline-images/docs/assets/webui-chat-light.png)

## Testing

- `go test ./...` green, `golangci-lint run` clean (0 issues).
- New server tests: authorized image bytes round-trip, 401 without token, 404 for no-media/missing-file/unknown pk, 415 for non-image bytes, 400 for bad pk.
- Headless Chromium verification: inline blob images load lazily, lightbox opens/closes on Escape, sticker rendering, and sidebar assertions — row node identity preserved across chat switch (no rebuild), scroll position stable, exactly one active row. No console errors.
